name: icc-incoterms
title: International Chamber of Commerce Incoterms
description: Current Incoterms (Incoterms 2020) used in international sale of goods as defined by the International Chamber of Commerce. Includes the 11 standard trade terms covering risk transfer, cost responsibility, and delivery obligations.

fields.name: Term
fields.description: 3-letter code identifying the Incoterm (e.g. EXW, FOB, CIF).

fields.name: Name

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Plain-language explanation of the delivery point, risk transfer, and cost obligations for the term.
